svg.title: MixRelay lettering review: comparison, glyph details and product family
svg.text: Eight original vector letters. Same symbol, same colors, same cap height.
Flatter R + e shoulders / short l foot / returning y
Fuller R + e bowls / straight l / direct diagonal y
M width + valley / R bowl + leg / e aperture
Square i dot / x intersection / l, a, y terminals
Lettering study; selected symbol and production assets retained.

g.text: Reference = current Helvetica Neue Regular / A and B = original contours
SPACING / ALL PAIRS ARE SET INDIVIDUALLY
Mi ix xR Re el la ay
Values refer to ink-box gaps in 100-unit cap geometry; optical review remains visual.
No font outline is used in either candidate.
This is lettering for one product name, not a full custom typeface.
Sonolog uses its existing outlined exploration; its identity is not changed.
A 75% composition is proposed for display; compact preserves 16px symbol / 10px type.
